doc.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

chapter: Ray Anthony and the big band end
title: Subbing for Buddy Weiss in the Anthony band
summary: He first subbed for tenor player Buddy Weiss, who had drug problems, and eventually got the job. Ray did not travel all the time.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: No I guess not. But we traveled. I was never on that band for like year in, year out traveling. First I started subbing for a wonderful tenor player who passed away named Buddy Weiss. He was a wonderful tenor player. But he had his problems with drug abuse. And he would get in trouble every so often and he’d have to leave the band and
then I’d fill in for him. And then eventually he was not there anymore so I had the job. But then Ray wasn’t traveling all the time either. He was staying around and would just go out occasionally.
